name: @medicine-wheel/app
statement: Medicine Wheel — Interactive visual layer for Indigenous relational research with Four Directions, ceremonies, and narrative arcs

name: @medicine-wheel/brainstorming
statement: Idea into committed design through approval gates a human holds. Every outcome it emits — including its own multiple-choice questions — passes the orientation question before it is spoken. Brainstorming, ideation, requirements gathering, design review.

name: @medicine-wheel/capabilities
statement: The platform-features and capabilities layer of the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite — what the platform can do, which repositories and services provide it, who said so and from what, with the 55-word statement limit and shared-capability detection

name: @medicine-wheel/ceremonial-diary
statement: Ceremonial Diary — a participant's voice across the Five-Phase ceremonial methodology. Intention, observation, and reflection entries with pattern detection, statistics, markdown export, and optional projection into the chronicle wheel. Persists through @medicine-wheel/storage-provider (jsonl and neon as first-class equals)

name: @medicine-wheel/ceremony-protocol
statement: Ceremony lifecycle protocol for Medicine Wheel — manages ceremony state, phase transitions, governance enforcement, and ceremonial review workflows

name: @medicine-wheel/client
statement: Typed HTTP client for a Medicine Wheel — nodes, edges, ceremonies, beats and the ceremonial diary — with the wheel's paging honesty carried through (count, total, truncated) and fail-fast errors that name the status.

name: @medicine-wheel/community-identity
statement: Who is in the circle: people as wheel nodes, roles with a permission map, circles and memberships as relations, invitations and self-issued credentials kept by the consumer — so a Medicine Wheel can tell two people apart.

name: @medicine-wheel/community-review
statement: Community-based ceremonial review protocol for Medicine Wheel — review circles, consensus and relational accountability, after the community-grounded credibility Wilson describes; the Elder step is the package's own design

name: @medicine-wheel/consent-lifecycle
statement: Ongoing relational consent lifecycle for the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite — consent as a living relational obligation, not a boolean checkbox

name: @medicine-wheel/creative-problem-solving
statement: Creative problem solving, routed at the door: name the prior state you are restoring. Named one: a gap analysis looks for what is missing against it, and the turn to the creative orientation follows. Named none: you are creating, and structural tension is the instrument. Re-exports @medicine-wheel/creative-orientation.

name: @medicine-wheel/data-store
statement: Shared Redis data-access layer for the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite — connection management, Node/Edge/Ceremony CRUD, session-ceremony linking, and discovery helpers

name: @medicine-wheel/data-store-postgres
statement: PostgreSQL/Neon provider scaffold for the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite — shared pool management and provider-ready storage entrypoints

name: @medicine-wheel/developer-repository-mapping
statement: Repository mapping for the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite — owner hubs of JSONL rows in <owner>/<owner>/.miadi/repository-mapping/, a lifecycle state machine checked against git, a meta mapping that reads other hubs without copying them, the projection into wheel nodes and edges, and the mw-repomap CLI with a small web page

name: @medicine-wheel/episode-vessel
statement: The file law of a chronicle episode folder, written once: bounded contained listing, text read and revision-guarded atomic write, ceremony notes and ceremony file attachments. No HTTP, no React, no service URL — a phone, a Next.js route and a test open the same vessel the same way.

name: @medicine-wheel/events
statement: The events a Medicine Wheel writes — catalog, MiadiEventEnvelope, JSON Schema and AsyncAPI document, the append-only events.jsonl log, the publisher seam a broker plugs into, and git carriage with a follower (mw-events)

name: @medicine-wheel/fire-keeper
statement: Fire Keeper coordination agent for Medicine Wheel — tends the ceremony fire, ensures relational integrity through gating conditions, and maintains Wilson alignment as an active agent

name: @medicine-wheel/github-ceremony
statement: GitHub-ceremony processing — witness GitHub webhook events (issues, pull requests, merges, commits) through a ceremonial lens and record them as relational ceremony beads. Pure, framework-free functions that take a parsed payload and a @medicine-wheel/storage-provider

name: @medicine-wheel/graph-viz
statement: Medicine Wheel graph visualization — circular layout with four-direction node positioning, ceremony-aware edges, and OCAP® indicators

name: @medicine-wheel/honcho
statement: The wheel's projection into Honcho — beats and ceremonies become Honcho messages, a speaker's evolving representation is recalled, and a derived conclusion is written back as a knowledge node. The wheel stays canonical; Honcho holds what the history has come to mean.

name: @medicine-wheel/importance-unit
statement: ImportanceUnit — the relational unit of knowledge for the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite. Carries epistemic weight, source dimensions (Land/Dream/Code/Vision), circle depth tracking, and accountability links grounded in Wilson's relational epistemology

name: @medicine-wheel/infra
statement: Typed infrastructure facets for the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite — hosts, tenants, services, and port bindings as facets keyed by relational node id, with port-conflict detection over declared ∪ observed state

name: @medicine-wheel/mcp
statement: Medicine Wheel MCP Server — Integrated Indigenous Paradigm Research Framework

name: @medicine-wheel/memory
statement: Asking the wheel's memory, whoever keeps it: one contract that names no provider (scope, reach, answer, source, provider), the rule that turns a scope into ceremonies, a text match over the wheel's own records, and the orchestration a wheel server or any caller shares. Zero dependencies.

name: @medicine-wheel/narrative-cluster
statement: Narrative Cluster Processor — turn witnessed perceptual events / rushes into thematic clusters, narrative beats, and a Film Edit Brief (EDL markers)

name: @medicine-wheel/narrative-engine
statement: Beat sequencing, arc validation, and ceremonial cadence engine for the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite

name: @medicine-wheel/ontology-core
statement: Foundational ontology layer for the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite — unified types, RDF vocabulary, Zod schemas, and semantic query helpers grounded in Indigenous relational ontology

name: @medicine-wheel/perception-layer
statement: Eyes & ears of agent-supported film production — witness a belt-device recording as typed perceptual events and seed a production knowledge graph

name: @medicine-wheel/prompt-decomposition
statement: Prompt Decomposition Engine for the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite — ontology-enriched intent extraction, relational dependency mapping, and ceremony-aware action stacking

name: @medicine-wheel/relational-index
statement: Four-source epistemic dimensional indexing for the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite — Land, Dream, Code, Vision traversal with cross-dimensional mapping and spiral depth metrics

name: @medicine-wheel/relational-query
statement: Query builder for relational webs with Indigenous protocol awareness — traversal, accountability, OCAP® compliance

name: @medicine-wheel/session-reader
statement: Session event reader for the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite — JSONL parsing, session summaries, analytics extraction, and search across agent session data

name: @medicine-wheel/transformation-tracker
statement: Research transformation tracking for the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite — built on a lesson Wilson quotes: if research doesn't change you as a person, you haven't done it right

name: @medicine-wheel/ui-components
statement: React UI components for the Medicine Wheel Developer Suite — direction cards, beat timelines, node inspectors

name: medicine-wheel-mcp
statement: The medicine-wheel-mcp command, shipped by @medicine-wheel/mcp.

name: mw
statement: The mw command, shipped by @medicine-wheel/app.

name: mw-events
statement: The mw-events command, shipped by @medicine-wheel/events.

name: mw-repomap
statement: The mw-repomap command, shipped by @medicine-wheel/developer-repository-mapping.

name: mwsrv
statement: The mwsrv command, shipped by @medicine-wheel/app.

name: api-health
statement: Read /api/health (the provider, whole-store counts, the Honcho projection and the event log) and check a wheel answers

name: ceremony-guide
statement: Open a ceremony bound to its episode and circle, list it, and close it with its learnings, by CLI or MCP

name: direction-inquiry
statement: Read a task through the Four Directions (East / South / West / North) with mw_decompose_prompt before acting on it

name: docker-setup
statement: Run the Medicine Wheel server in Docker with mwsrv --docker, and check that it answers

name: drift-reconciliation
statement: Compare declared vs observed infrastructure state and propose healing steps

name: fire-keeper-check
statement: Before an action, read the Fire Keeper status of its inquiry and run the four-step relational check-back

name: infra-topology
statement: The registered topology — hosts, tenants, services, ports — and its drift, via MCP

name: infrastructure-audit
statement: Audit hosts, services, and port bindings across the Medicine Wheel estate

name: precondition-guard
statement: Evaluate infrastructure preconditions (linger, port-free, unit-present, working-directory) against the consent that authorizes them

name: service-provisioning
statement: Propose and gate service deployment through ceremony-aware preconditions

name: session-manager
statement: Read what a recorded agent session did, from its _sessiondata events, with mw_analyze_session

name: storage-config
statement: Choose the storage provider (JSONL by default, Neon with a database URL) and check that the server took it

name: wave-spec-generator
statement: Turn a goal into a wave bundle in a .pde vessel, decomposed with mw_decompose_prompt and written by hand
